CIG Shanghai.why: optical-module maker whose high-speed (800G/1.6T) transceiver sales for overseas cloud customers drove H1 2026 revenue up 32.92% and net profit up 171.08%
CIG Shanghai.evidence: CIG Shanghai IR activity record: 2026-003 (09-07-2026): H1 2026 growth mainly from high-speed optical modules; 800G certified by several major customers and shipping in volume; 1.6T mass production expected in H2 2026

players.product: 800G and 1.6T OSFP optical transceivers (silicon-photonics and EML designs), ELSFP external light sources, and NPO/CPO optical engines in development

quarterly_data.signal: Management (IR record, CIOE 2026): products shown included several 800G OSFP products already in mass production, 1.6T OSFP products, ELSFP external light sources and 6.4T/7.2T NPO prototypes.

Management (IR record): the whole industry faces a DSP chip shortage for 1.6T products; if it is effectively resolved it will help the 1.6T ramp. Next year's module capacity is expected to grow substantially from the current base.
Management (IR record): the company is doing custom NPO development with several customers including leading cloud providers, with samples expected to go out for testing in H2.
